question: Choose the antonym of 'durable':
solution: The correct answer is: **Fragile**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"durable"** means something that is strong and able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage over time. (टिकाऊ) • **Example:** This furniture is made of durable materials and can last for decades. • **"Fragile"** refers to something that is delicate, easily broken, or damaged. (नाजुक) • **Example:** Handle the glass vase carefully; it is very fragile. • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'durable'** is **'fragile'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fragile**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Strong** (मजबूत): Having great physical power or strength. • **Example:** The bridge is strong enough to support heavy vehicles. • **Sturdy** (मजबूत): Firmly built or robust in structure. • **Example:** The backpack is sturdy and can hold heavy books. • **Firm** (दृढ़): Solid, strong, or unyielding. • **Example:** She has a firm belief in justice and equality. 1a3:T58e,
